text.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

words.gloss_range: this, here; a near feminine demonstrative that opens by pointing before the named predicate resolves it

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the predicate that resolves the opening demonstrative

words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذِهِۦ}} ({{tr:hādhihi}}) opens with a near pointing act: the reader first receives 'this,' then {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}) supplies the name. The feminine singular form keeps the pointer locked to that predicate, so the first beat is a verbless identification, not a report of arrival or movement. Its presentative force makes the denied reality feel shown before it is discussed, and the light deictic cadence leaves the heavier predicate to land after it. The alternate hādhī ending preserves the same demonstrative function, so the payoff stays with deictic display rather than a different referent.

topics.headline: near demonstrative stages the display
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by showing a present referent before naming it, so denial is confronted with display.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is locally resolved by the following predicate and carries near deixis; no guardrail evidence redirects it to a prior noun.

topics.headline: feminine nominal clause gives direct identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening beat identifies the pointed reality directly as Jahannam before the relative clause adds accusation.
topics.reason: The feminine singular demonstrative agrees with the grammatically feminine predicate, and the nominal clause is syntactically forced.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that form and cadence reinforce a recitable pointing word, while the variant evidence does not change the local referent.
topics.reason: The variant and cadence rows support demonstrative pressure; they are narrowed because they do not create a separate lexical sense or antecedent.

words.prose: {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}) completes the opening identification: {{ar:هَٰذِهِۦ}} ({{tr:hādhihi}}) does not point toward a destination but is equated with the named reality. As a proper, diptote name, it is definite and unique, not a generic label for suffering. The noun becomes the grammatical center of the ayah: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) and {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) keep returning to it, while the final {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}) names the class that denies it. The foreign-place background and deep-abyss explanation are useful as pressure on the name, but the local sense remains the eschatological proper noun. Inter-ayah echoes sharpen the field: criminals are linked with Jahannam in punishment scenes (43:74; 20:74; 19:86), and denial formulas around Jahannam appear in 39:32, 39:60, and 29:68; here those patterns are compressed into direct display.

topics.headline: proper noun stands as the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pointed reality is identified as the known proper name Jahannam, not compared with Hell or described as one punishment among many.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the noun the nominative predicate of the demonstrative, and the proper-name/diptote profile supports definiteness.

topics.headline: Jahannam anchors the reference chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first fixes Jahannam, then makes the relative clause and pronoun circle back to that same named object.
topics.reason: The feminine agreement chain and two-beat structure are locally forced: predicate first, then relative clause specifying denial.

topics.headline: proper name carries depth and place pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abyssal and concrete-place pressure behind the name, while still reading the local word as the proper eschatological name.
topics.reason: The etymological rows are coherent as background pressure, but local proper-name grammar prevents replacing the selected sense with a generic deep-well noun.

topics.headline: corpus pairings make displayed Hell the denied object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recurring punishment and denial formulas are made local: Jahannam is no longer only a destination elsewhere but the displayed object denied here.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete parallels with denial and criminality fields; they sharpen the local relation without overriding the local predicate parse.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) is the hinge that keeps the second beat from becoming a separate sentence. Its feminine singular and definite shape binds the clause to {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}), so the denial that follows identifies the already displayed referent. The word packages definiteness, relativity, and gender in one compact form; it lets the ayah move from 'this is Jahannam' to 'the one which is denied' without repeating the noun. In recitation, its flow into {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}) keeps the denial clause attached rather than parenthetical.

topics.headline: feminine relative binds the antecedent

topics.reason: The relative pronoun agrees with and modifies the definite feminine antecedent; attachment evidence marks the relative clause as adjectival.

topics.reason: The relative marker routes the verbal denial clause back to the predicate, making the second beat identify the first.

topics.reason: The sound observation is modest and local; it reinforces attachment without creating a separate grammatical claim.

words.prose: {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}) gives the relative clause its action: an indicative imperfect, so the denial is stated as current or habitual, not as a past episode, wish, or command. Its Form II shape selects active falsification: the criminals are not merely lying in general but declaring the displayed reality false. The verb governs {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}), the fixed target-marking complement, which routes the denial back to {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}). Because the singular verb comes before {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}), the act and its object are heard before the agent is named. The boundary from the refrain's second-dual challenge in 55:42 to this third-person report answers the open denial with an indictment, while related denial scenes (10:17; 7:40; 39:32) sharpen the same field. The doubled middle sound reinforces the Form II pressure without replacing the grammatical evidence.

topics.headline: imperfect indicative makes denial ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is presented as an active ongoing practice inside the relative clause, not a completed past event.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect indicative inside the relative clause; no local particle makes it conditional, jussive, subjunctive, or imperative.

topics.headline: Form II selects declaring false over simple lying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge is outward falsification of a displayed object, not merely producing false speech.
topics.reason: The Form II stem and local complement select denial or declaring false; broader lying senses remain root-family background.

topics.headline: bi-complement fixes the denial target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of denial is carried by the prepositional complement, so Jahannam is the content rejected rather than an instrument or setting.
topics.reason: Attachment and valency evidence both support the bi-complement frame, with the semantic object in the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: verb-object order delays the accusing subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause hears denial and its target before revealing the criminals as the responsible class.
topics.reason: The singular pre-subject verb is standard VSO agreement, and the following prepositional object postpones the explicit plural subject.

topics.headline: refrain root shifts into third-person indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refrain-root of denial moves from direct dual challenge (55:42) into a report naming the deniers of Jahannam.
topics.reason: The same-surah and cross-reference rows provide concrete echoes; they explain boundary movement without changing the local verb parse.

topics.headline: gemination audibly supports emphatic denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubled sound makes the denial feel pressed and emphatic, while sound remains supportive rather than proof of meaning.
topics.reason: The shaddah is local and compatible with Form II, but the lexical selection rests on morphology and complement structure, not sound symbolism alone.

words.prose: {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) is small but structurally loaded. Its feminine suffix routes back to {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}), continuing the chain already carried by {{ar:هَٰذِهِۦ}} ({{tr:hādhihi}}) and {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}); that agreement prevents the complement from drifting toward the criminals or the act of denial itself. The preposition is governed by {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}) as the target of denial, not as an instrument, so the clause means rejection of that displayed reality. Because this fused preposition-plus-suffix stands before {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}), the denied object registers before the deniers are named. It also answers the open denial from 55:42 by making the object local and explicit through a pronoun rather than by repeating the noun.

topics.headline: feminine suffix resumes Jahannam

topics.reason: The suffix is syntactically forced as a feminine singular resumptive pronoun referring to Jahannam inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: bi marks the denied target

topics.reason: The complement is governed by the denial verb, and the construction selects target-marking over instrumental force.

topics.headline: bound form compresses reference and governance

topics.reason: The fused preposition and suffix are local formal facts, and variant rows preserve the complement even when the address frame changes.

topics.reason: The local order places the complement between verb and subject, making the object of denial audible before the agent category.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}) is the delayed answer to the clause's agency question. After {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}) and {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) have already named the act and its target, the final noun reveals who performs it. Its definiteness makes the group a known class, especially after the same category was recognized in 55:41, and its nominative case makes them the acting subject. The Form IV active participle turns criminality into a standing culpable identity rather than a single event of offending; the finite verb slot is reserved for their denial. The root's severing and acquiring-liability imagery colors that identity as rupture and accumulated blame, but the local sense remains the moral agent category. Cross-surah pairings with Jahannam (43:74; 20:74; 19:86) and denial contexts (10:17; 7:40; 12:110) make the final word land as the class whose denial closes the confrontation. Variant direct-address material highlights the standard reading by contrast: this ayah closes with classification, not direct sentencing.

topics.headline: sentence-final subject seals the indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah withholds the agent until the end, so the final landing is the identity of the deniers.
topics.reason: The noun is the explicit nominative subject after the verb and prepositional complement, creating clause-final focus on agency.

topics.headline: definite plural names a known class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the text says the criminals, an already identifiable class recalled from 55:41, not an indefinite set of offenders.
topics.reason: The definite article and same-surah antecedent support familiar definiteness, while the masculine sound plural marks the group as a recognized class.

topics.headline: active participle makes guilt an agent identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that criminality is a settled participial identity carrying moral agency into the subject position.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite active participle from Form IV, and contextual evidence supports the participial group as a dominant profile.

topics.headline: root image colors culpability as severance and liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the severance and acquired-liability pressure behind the criminal label, while local grammar keeps the word as the culpable agent noun.
topics.reason: The root-image rows are meaningful as semantic coloring, but they do not replace the local active-participle sense with a concrete cutting action.

topics.headline: criminality joins Jahannam and denial fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final subject gathers two fields at once: criminals are paired with Jahannam elsewhere and here are syntactically defined by denial.
topics.reason: The cross-reference rows name concrete punishment and denial contexts; locally the connection is direct because the criminals are the subject of the denial verb.

topics.headline: variant contrast highlights classification over address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard reading closes with third-person criminal classification, while variant address material functions only as contrast.
topics.reason: The variant rows illuminate the discourse choice but are narrowed because they do not govern the canonical local parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The demonstrative identification 'this is Jahannam' stands directly against 'which the criminals declare false.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The relative clause preserves the criminals' false attribution while the demonstrative presents its referent; the denied object becomes the evidence that overturns denial.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or report false supplies the attribution that the demonstrative presentation reverses.
Guilt and offense identify the agents whose denial is exposed by the presented referent.

changed_reading.before: A warning that guilty people verbally deny Hell.
changed_reading.after: A scene of evidentiary pointing: the object labeled false is now present and functions as its own refutation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active imperfect 'they declare false' is paired with the agent label 'the mujrimun.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The earning/incurring branch of j-r-m lets the noun remain a legal label while also portraying an identity continually acquired through false speech and action.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action supplies the continuing conduct linked to the agents.
Earning or causing an incurrence turns criminality from a static label into an acquired condition.
The offense branch keeps the acquired-condition reading anchored in actual culpability.

changed_reading.before: The criminals are a pre-existing class who happen to deny Jahannam.
changed_reading.after: Their ongoing falsification is part of what they earn and what makes the criminal identity operative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cut-off imagery latent in 'mujrimun' meets the suddenly present 'this' and the denied referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The j-r-m harvest branches cast the agents as what is cut away or left after cutting, while the k-dh-b failed-expectation branch casts denial as confidence that the threatened outcome will not endure or arrive.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting give the criminal label an exploratory image of being severed from continuity.
Harvest residue supplies the image of what remains after the decisive cutting.
An expected supply that fails to last models denial as a failed expectation about persistence or nonarrival.

changed_reading.before: Generic sinners encounter a punishment they rejected.
changed_reading.after: The deniers reach a cutoff at which their expectation fails and they appear as the severed residue of their own course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from mercy through teaching to clarification turns the focus demonstrative into a severe act of disclosure, not only a threat.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy frames the communicative sequence in which the later warning is disclosed.
Making something known supplies the pedagogical movement from hidden or disputed to disclosed.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign makes the focus demonstrative function like a final pointing sign.
The false attribution is the epistemic condition that this severe clarification answers.

structural_cues: The surah opens with mercy, teaching, creation, and taught clarification before it later says 'this is Jahannam.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, making-known, clarification, and a later deictic sentence; I infer that the deictic participates in the teaching sequence, while the live alternative is that it is simply a punitive announcement.

changed_reading.before: The demonstrative is only threatening presentation.
changed_reading.after: The demonstrative is also hard pedagogy: what denial kept unreal is made unmistakably knowable within the surah's economy of clarification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation, just balance, and the ban on short measure activate j-r-m as earning: the focus names the settlement of an accumulated false stance.

activation_trace.role: Counting and calculation supply an ordered account rather than an arbitrary outcome.
The balance of justice supplies the norm against which the incurred offense is settled.
Equity and fair dealing make exactness, not excess, the governing principle of the account.
Shortchanging a measure supplies the prohibited distortion that denial itself attempts at the level of truth.
Earning and incurring connect the measured order to the agents' acquired consequence.

structural_cues: The early sequence moves from cosmic calculation to a placed balance and then commands exact weight without loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, just measure, non-shortchanging, and earning; I supply the arrow from moral falsification to a settled account, while an alternative keeps the balance commands and Jahannam as separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam appears as an unspecified penalty for denial.
changed_reading.after: It appears as the exact settlement of an earned distortion, under the same order that forbids short measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly distinguishes human and jinn, but near the focus both are gathered into the action-based category of mujrimun; culpable acquisition crosses species identity.

activation_trace.role: The visible human category supplies one member of the paired accountable populations.
The hidden jinn category supplies the other member without erasing its distinct mode of being.
Offense supplies the shared culpability category that replaces species labels in the immediate sequence.
Earning makes the shared class an acquired relation rather than an inherited kind.

structural_cues: Human and jinn are paired through the surah and named together in 55:39, while 55:41 and 55:43 identify the relevant group simply as the criminals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two species and a subsequent common offense label; I infer that conduct reorganizes social identity, while the alternative is that mujrimun merely abbreviates two already known groups.

changed_reading.before: The criminals are an undifferentiated crowd.
changed_reading.after: They are a cross-species class constituted by incurred conduct, showing denial to be a common relation rather than a property of one kind of creature.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sequence of related spatial operations moves from a relation that prevents transgression, through failed penetration of cosmic sides without authority, to circulation around the denied place.

activation_trace.role: A connection maintained between distinct sides supplies the relational boundary pattern.
Crossing the limit by aggression supplies the movement that the earlier boundary prevents.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted escape operation.
Sides and regions give the escape attempt a bounded cosmic topology.
Effective power and jurisdiction define the only stated condition for passage.
Circling replaces successful outward passage with recurrent bounded movement.
Declaring Jahannam false anchors this spatial regime as the very reality the agents refused.

structural_cues: The sequence first preserves a boundary, later challenges the two populations to penetrate cosmic sides, and finally places them in repeated movement linked by a pronoun to Jahannam.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransgression, conditional penetration, and circling; I infer one escalating limit-regime, while the alternative treats the sea boundary, cosmic challenge, and punishment as independent scenes.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is a static destination named after failed belief.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam is the terminal topology of failed passage: denied limits become an enclosure in which outward motion collapses into circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perishing, remaining, recurring time, imminent presence, and attained ripeness activate the time-completion branch of j-r-m and the failed-duration branch of k-dh-b.

activation_trace.role: Ending after a period of persistence supplies the horizon against which denial gambles on delay.
Continuance supplies the contrast that distinguishes what lasts from what reaches an end.
A duration of time supplies recurring administration rather than an empty wait.
An affair drawing near and becoming present turns the post-focus heat into arrival, not abstraction.
Reaching due maturity supplies the image of a consequence whose time has fully ripened.
Completed and cut-off time gives the criminal label a deadline shadow.
A supply expected to continue but failing models the deniers' temporal expectation collapsing.

structural_cues: The surah contrasts universal perishing with remaining, then immediately after the focus describes a heated destination as having reached its due state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endings, continuance, recurring time, nearness, and ripeness; I infer that denial includes a temporal bet on nonarrival, while an alternative reads these as unrelated descriptions of mortality and heat.

changed_reading.before: Denial is rejection of a timeless doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a failed timing judgment: the deniers presume delay or nonarrival until the demonstrative marks the completed deadline.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to pass beyond the cosmic bounds is answered by dispatched flame and smoke with no successful aid; the focus then names the denied reality as an active enclosure response.

activation_trace.role: An open passage supplies the route the challenged populations seek but do not possess on their own.
Compelling proof or warrant supplies the stated exception to failed escape.
Dispatch and propulsion turn fire from scenery into an answering force.
Smokeless flame supplies the material that blocks or overtakes the escape attempt.
Smoke without flame adds a second enveloping medium to the dispatched response.
Aid and prevailing support supply what the pair explicitly cannot marshal.
The denied attribution makes the resulting enclosure an epistemic reversal as well as a physical one.

structural_cues: The escape challenge in 55:33 is followed by a dispatched fiery response in 55:35 and the deictic naming in 55:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenge, failed passage, dispatched material, and absent aid; I infer that the focus names the culmination of that containment, while the alternative keeps each warning as a separate eschatological image.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is an unseen place reached later.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam is also the activated enclosure that answers attempted escape and makes the denied limit materially operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky splits and becomes rose-like and oil-like before the focus; this changing visible surface activates k-dh-b's deceptive-cloth branch and recasts denial as trust in a surface that cannot remain stable.

activation_trace.role: Splitting open breaks the apparent continuity of the familiar cosmic surface.
Rose color supplies the newly visible appearance after the split.
Oil or coating supplies a material surface analogy for the transformed sky.
Patterned cloth that deceives by its condition turns falsification into an exploratory problem of misleading surfaces.

structural_cues: The visible sky changes material and color six ayat before the denied Jahannam is demonstratively presented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split, recolored, oil-like sky and a deceptive-surface branch in the focus root; I infer an epistemic surface reversal, while the alternative is a purely visual transformation with no claim about why the criminals denied.

changed_reading.before: The criminals deny a proposition despite stable visible reality.
changed_reading.after: Their denial can be heard as overconfidence in ordinary appearances, which the transformed cosmic surface strips of evidentiary authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition by visible marks and seizure at opposite bodily ends immediately precede the focus, so a disputed proposition becomes an embodied, indexed exhibit.

activation_trace.role: Recognition after a trace or sign supplies the explicit move from uncertainty to identification.
Clear color gives the criminal label a branch-level visual clarity alongside the stated marks.
A visible distinguishing mark supplies the bodily evidence by which the agents are known.
Grasping and capture turn recognition into physical custody.
The forelock supplies one concrete handle of the seized body.
The feet supply the opposite bodily endpoint, making the capture total and spatially legible.
Bodily bulk and shaped mass make the focus label attach to embodied agents rather than an abstract legal class.
The denied attribution is answered by people and destination becoming mutually identifiable in the scene.

structural_cues: 55:41 recognizes criminals by marks and seizes forelocks and feet; after one refrain, 55:43 points to the place they denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition, marks, capture, and deictic naming; I infer that embodiment resolves the epistemic dispute, while an alternative treats the marks as identifying people only, not as answering their denial.

changed_reading.before: Denial is refuted by an external place being shown.
changed_reading.after: Denial is refuted through a double exhibit: the criminals become visibly readable and the destination they denied becomes demonstratively readable with them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated dual second-person accusation becomes a third-person plural report in the focus and then returns to dual address, making 'the criminals' a live identity offered to the hearers rather than a remote group.

activation_trace.role: The second-person dual act of declaring false directly addresses both hearer populations before the focus.
The same false-attribution act is recast in third-person plural and attached to the criminal category.
The return to second-person dual address reopens the category as an immediate possibility for the hearers.

structural_cues: The grammar moves from 'you two declare false' in 55:42 to 'the criminals declare false' in 55:43 and back to 'you two declare false' in 55:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical denial language around a person-and-number shift; I infer identity pressure between addressee and criminal, while the alternative is a rhetorical exemplum that does not equate them.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports what a distant criminal group believes.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a grammatical hinge that briefly objectifies the current addressees under the identity their continued denial could actualize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Jahannam identification and its circulating aftermath are enclosed by the refrain about the favors of a nurturing Lord, pressing even this severe disclosure into the surah's gift-accounting frame.

activation_trace.role: Merciful tenderness supplies the distant governing frame that makes the punishment bracket surprising.
Favors and benefits supply the explicit category named immediately before the focus.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply a corrective rather than merely possessive shade to lordship.
The denied referent is the severe disclosure placed inside the favor refrain's frame.
Repeated false attribution closes the bracket and returns the scene to direct moral interrogation.

structural_cues: A refrain naming the Lord's favors occurs at 55:42, the focus names Jahannam at 55:43, 55:44 depicts circulation, and the refrain recurs at 55:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact favor-refrain bracket; I infer that warning, disclosure, or maintained order may be the beneficent aspect, not that pain itself is lexically called a favor. The live alternative is that the refrain continues rhythmically without reclassifying the intervening scene.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated interruption of the surah's favor catalog.
changed_reading.after: The focus remains inside that catalog as a severe disclosed sign whose possible benefit lies in warning, truth, and the refusal to let denial erase consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah carries Jahannam forward by pronoun as one pole of repeated motion between it and fully ripened hot water; the denied noun becomes a process architecture.

activation_trace.role: The false-attributed object supplies the pole that becomes physically unavoidable in the next movement.
The interval between two things supplies the two-pole geometry of the punishment.
Rotation around or recurrently about something turns the geometry into a loop rather than a single arrival.
Hot water supplies the second material pole of the loop.
Attained ripeness makes that second pole fully due and complete.

structural_cues: The feminine pronoun in 55:44 links its 'between it' directly back to Jahannam in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circling and a two-pole interval; I assign the circuit or negative-circumambulation shape, while the materially live alternative is simple forced shuttling without ritual resonance.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is a place at which the deniers arrive.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam is one pole of an enforced recurrent circuit, so denial is answered not by one sighting but by inescapable repeated encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the punishment circuit, anticipating the standing before one's Lord opens onto two gardens; denial and fear become rival temporal stances with divergent spatial outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the destination false supplies the stance that refuses anticipatory recognition.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies the alternative stance that acts before encounter.
Standing or remaining in a station supplies the anticipated scene before the Lord.
Lordship and authority supply the relation before which the standing is anticipated.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the divergent destination opened by anticipatory fear.
Incurring supplies the causal bridge from stance and conduct to divergent outcome.

structural_cues: 55:43-44 joins denial to Jahannam and its circuit; after the refrain, 55:46 joins fear of standing before the Lord to two gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent denial and anticipatory-fear stances with opposed destinations; I infer a behavioral fork, while the alternative is a simple contrast between two fixed populations.

changed_reading.before: Criminals and garden-dwellers are externally sorted groups.
changed_reading.after: The focus sits at a fork between refusing a future encounter and anticipating it; those epistemic-temporal stances help generate the two spatial trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later fruit-gathering carries a branch of drawing offense upon oneself, and the explicit rule of recompense clarifies j-r-m earning as a self-incurred harvest rather than arbitrary assignment.

activation_trace.role: Taking fruit from its growth supplies the concrete harvest pattern.
Drawing an offense onto oneself converts the fruit harvest into a moral self-harvest analogy.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit reciprocal rule.
Doing good supplies the positive case through which reciprocity is stated.
Earning and causing to incur supply the focus-side mechanism of self-acquired consequence.

structural_cues: The post-focus garden sequence places near fruit before stating that good is recompensed by good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fruit gathering, self-drawn offense, recompense, and earning; I infer a reciprocal harvest mechanism, while the alternative keeps garden fruit and legal consequence as separate images.

changed_reading.before: The criminals receive a destination assigned from outside.
changed_reading.after: Their destination is the negative side of a reciprocal harvest: they gather onto themselves the consequence their denial has been earning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the running-then-stopping branch is idiomatic and form-distant from ordinary denial. It remains anchored in the focus k-dh-b occurrence and is activated by failed penetration followed by circling; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The k-dh-b verb in 'they declare it false' can carry a branch-shadow of running a stage and then stopping to look back.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping to look behind supplies the strange kinetic image inside the denial root.
Attempted clean passage supplies the outward run from the threatened limit.
Circling supplies the failed run's conversion into recurrent motion around the denied reality.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a false assertion about Jahannam.
changed_reading.after: Denial also resembles abortive flight: an outward run that cannot pass through, stops, and is converted into circling encounter with what it fled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins lexicographic cloth, furnishing, and lie branches across punishment and garden imagery. It remains anchored in the focus act of falsification and in explicit later textiles; render it as a material analogy for fabrication and surface, not as an equation of the actual furnishings with falsehood.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus k-dh-b inventory includes a patterned cloth whose appearance deceives, allowing denial to be imagined as a surface laid over reality.

activation_trace.role: A patterned cloth that deceives by appearance supplies the material image of fabricated surface.
Spread furnishings make the surface analogy tactile and bodily supportive.
The separate lying branch makes fabrication coexist lexically with the spread-furnishing image.
A textile lining supplies an inner layer beneath visible surface, sharpening the appearance-versus-inside contrast.
Rare patterned carpets extend the material field in which extraordinary claims can be mistaken for fabrication.

changed_reading.before: The criminals simply label a proposition false.
changed_reading.after: Their denial can be pictured as laying a persuasive patterned surface over the real, while the surah later makes promised realities tactile down to spread and lining.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the obligation formula is a remote branch and does not grammatically replace the form-II verb in the focus. It remains rooted in k-dh-b and gains force from the immediate arrival language; downstream prose should mark it as ironic branch resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denied Jahannam is demonstratively pressed into presence, while k-dh-b also has a formulaic branch meaning that something is incumbent or urged upon someone.

activation_trace.role: The formula of incurrence or urging supplies an ironic reversal within the same root as denial.
Repeated direct accusation gives the ironic incurrence resonance an addressed target immediately before the focus.
Nearness and presence supply the movement by which what was rejected becomes imposed encounter.

changed_reading.before: They reject Jahannam as having no claim on them.
changed_reading.after: The clause carries an ironic branch echo: the very reality they deny is now present and, as consequence, incumbent upon them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because remote garden vocabulary supplies the activation and one branch is sharply distant from the surface sense. It remains anchored in the focus's false-attribution act and in packet branches that co-locate astonishment with pure fabrication; render it as a hypothesis about the psychology of denial, not a gloss or excuse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names denial without stating why the claim seemed deniable, leaving room for later wonder branches to activate a plausibility-threshold reading.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the referent false anchors the question of what made it seem beyond belief.
A wondrous thing supplies the category of reality that exceeds ordinary expectation.
Rare astonishing excellence supplies the extraordinary pole of the plausibility threshold.
A separate pure-fabrication branch supplies the nearby lexical possibility of dismissing the extraordinary as made up.

changed_reading.before: The criminals deny from generic dishonesty or obstinacy.
changed_reading.after: Their denial may also be refusal at the threshold where terrifying and beautiful realities sound too extraordinary to count as real.

strongest_changes: The denied referent becomes a deictically present exhibit that refutes its own false attribution.
The refrain's shift from dual second person to third-person criminals and back makes criminal identity a live possibility for the hearers.
Boundary, failed penetration, and circling cues turn Jahannam from a static destination into an enforced spatial circuit.
Recognition by marks and bodily seizure make the epistemic dispute visible and embodied.
Measure, earning, harvest, and recompense recast punishment as exact self-incurred consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah acts as a hinge where proposition becomes exhibit, addressed denial becomes an acquired public identity, and an unseen destination becomes a timed, embodied, bounded encounter. Branch-distant cues also keep kinetic flight, deceptive textile, ironic incurrence, and wonder-threshold readings alive without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The favor-refrain bracket may frame warning and disclosed order as benefit, or it may be rhetorical cadence without that semantic pressure.
The circuit reading is secure as repeated bounded motion, but its negative-circumambulation resonance remains analogical.
Harvest, color, textile, and kinetic models depend on distant branch images and should coexist with, not replace, the direct denial-and-offense reading.
The sequence supports an acquired criminal identity, but it does not prove that denial alone exhausts the category.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Deictic presence overturns declaration of falsehood.** `ك ذ ب/B002` gives declaring something false; “this” supplies immediate presentation. I infer that direct presence reverses the prior speech-act without further argument. The ayah reads as reality's demonstrative answer to denial.
2. **Crime as cutting off what should be joined.** `ج ر م/B001` supplies culpable offense, while the packet's boundary and connection network activates its separating force. I infer that persistent denial severs the actor from truthful relation until the denied object becomes the actor's environment. This is an abductive social reading anchored in `مجرمون`.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:46 moves immediately after the refrain to those who feared standing before their Lord. The contrast reveals that anticipation preserves relation, while denial ends in forced presence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`ك ذ ب` `B002` — “declare or deny as false,” with `ج ر م` `B003` — “acquire or incur.”** Structural cue: the near demonstrative presents the named object, and the relative clause identifies it as exactly what the offenders deny. Assigned role: deictic presence displaces verbal denial, while the incurred branch assigns the offenders a causal relation to the displayed outcome. Packet evidence is the demonstrative-relative construction and the accepted branches. Inference: the consequence becomes self-authenticating when what was denied is made immediately present to those who incurred it. Reading change: the ayah is a confrontation between claim and disclosed result.

Suçlular, yalnız bir sonucu görmez; işledikleriyle edinip üzerlerine aldıkları sonuçla karşı karşıya gelirler.
Suç kökünün ayırma çağrışımından hareketle inkârın kişiyi doğru ilişkiden kopardığı ileri sürülebilir; fakat bağlam bu toplumsal mekanizmayı açıkça kurmaz.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wrongdoing is acquired, cut away like a harvest, leaves residue, and yields an assigned share of consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Crime is rendered as a productive but destructive process: an act is earned, reaches completion, is cut off, and leaves a gatherable remainder. The bucket, share, and scoop imagery gives consequence a measured materiality, as though the offender receives the yield of what was accumulated.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çeşitli renklerle boyanmış veya desenlenmiş bir kumaşı, dokuma yoluyla bezenmiş gibi görünmesi üzerinden tanımlar; bir açıklama bu yanıltıcı görünüşü adlandırmanın gerekçesi yapar. Geçici çerçeve nesneyi ve görünüş ilişkisini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, boyası veya deseni gerçek dokuma bezemesi sanısı veren kumaşla sınırlıdır; genel yalan, her desenli kumaş veya kişi adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bir kumaş adını ve onu ayıran görünüş özelliğini verir; genel aldatıcı görünüş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Çeşitli renklerle boyanmış veya desenlenmiş, bu yüzden dokuma yoluyla bezenmiş gibi görünen bir kumaş ya da giysidir.

facets.statement: Nesne, çeşitli boya renkleriyle renklendirilmiş veya yüzeyine desen işlenmiş bir kumaştır.
Boya ve desen, kumaşın dokuma yoluyla bezenmiş olduğu izlenimini verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çeşitli renklerle boyanıp desenlenen ve böylece dokuma bezemesi varmış gibi görünen bir kumaş üzerinde birleşir; toplu kanıt bu yanıltıcı görünüşü adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak açıklar.

contextual_glosses.text: dokuma desenli gibi görünen boyalı kumaş

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam ağı, söz ve davranışta doğruluğa aykırılık ile başkasını yalan sayma çekirdeğinden; yükümlülük, savaş hamlesi, gecikmeme, süt kesilmesi, hayvan hareketi, iç benlik ve kumaş görünüşü gibi sözlüksel olarak özelleşmiş alanlara uzanır. Bu alanların bir bölümü yalan veya beklentinin boşa çıkması düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilebilirken bir bölümü bağımsızlaşmış adlandırmalar olarak kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamın merkezine kesip ayırmayı yerleştirir; hurma ürününü ağaçtan kesme, koyun yününü kırkma ve keserek alma kullanımları bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Köklü bir oluşuma ilişkin açıklama ise bağımsız bir temel anlam değil, kesilmiş bir toprak parçası tasarımına dayanan türetim yorumudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam kesme eylemidir; hasat, kırkma ve keserek alma bunun bağlama bağlı görünümleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kesme anlamı ile hurma hasadı, yün kırkma ve birinden keserek alma gibi belirli yapılara bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bütününden keserek ayırmak ve böylece ondan bir parça almaktır. Hurma ürününü ağaçtan kesip toplama ile koyun yününü kırkma bu işlemin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi keserek bütününden ayırma ve ayrılan parçayı alma eylemidir.
Hurma ürününü ağaçtan kesip toplama ve bu işin zamanı için kullanılır.
Koyun yününü kesip alma, yani hayvanı kırkma işlemini anlatır.
Köklü bir oluşum, yerden kesilmiş bir parçanın oraya çöküp yerleşmesi biçiminde türetimsel olarak açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, kesip ayırma çekirdeğini hurma hasadı, yün kırkma ve keserek alma örnekleriyle doğrular. Ayrıca bir oluşumun adı, topraktan ayrılmış bir parçanın yerleşmesi tasarımına bağlanan türetimsel bir açıklamayla anılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme, ayırma ve ayrılan parçayı alma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قطع الشيء وصرام النخل وقطع الثمرة عن الشجر وجز صوف الشاة وأخذ الشيء بالقطع، ومعه شاهد جرثومة بوصفها مركبة من جرم وجثم عند مقاييس
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الذنب أو الكسب أو تمام الزمن إلا من جهة اشتقاقها من أصل القطع
branches.source_phrase_ar: فالجرم القطع؛ لصرام النخل الجرام؛ جرمت صوف الشاة وأخذته (maqayis)؛ الجرم القطع وقد جرم النخل واجترمه أي صرمه وجرمت صوف الشاة أي جززته (sihah)؛ جرمه يجرمه جرما إذا قطعه؛ جرم النخل وجزمه إذا خرصه وجززه (tahdhib)؛ أصل الجرم قطع الثمرة عن الشجر (mufradat)؛ جرثومة من كلمتين من جرم وجثم كأنه اقتطع من الأرض قطعة فجثم فيها (maqayis-routing)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca hasat kalıntısını değil, kuru hurmayı, çekirdeği, çekirdeğin dövüldüğü çukuru, salkımın çıktığı çekirdeği ve bölgesel bir yiyecek ölçüsünü de bir araya getirir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak tek tür bir artık olarak değil, hasat sonrası ürünler ve sözlükselleşmiş yan kullanımlar kümesi olarak sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek ve kuru ürün çekirdeğe yakındır; çukur, tek çekirdek ve yiyecek ölçüsü bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hasat sonrası ürün anlamları ile yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen yiyecek ölçüsü ve tek çekirdek kullanımları birbirine genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Hurma kesiminden sonra düşen ya da toplanan artık ile kuru hurma veya çekirdektir. Belirli kullanımlarda çekirdek dövme çukurunu, salkımın çıktığı tek çekirdeği ya da bölgesel bir yiyecek ölçüsünü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Hurma kesiminden sonra yere düşen veya sonradan toplanan ürün artığıdır.
Kuru hurma ve hurma çekirdeği için kullanılan adları kapsar.
Çekirdeğin dövüldüğü çukur veya salkımın çıktığı tek çekirdek için de kullanılır.
Bölgesel kullanımda bir müd tutarındaki yiyecek miktarını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtın ortak ekseni hurma hasadı sonrasında kalan ya da toplanan üründür; kuru hurma ile çekirdek adlandırmaları bu eksende birleşir. Aynı toplu kanıt ayrıca çekirdek dövme çukurunu, salkımın çıktığı çekirdeği ve bölgesel bir yiyecek ölçüsünü kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi kazanıp elde etme çekirdeğini açıkça verir ve aile için kazanan kişiyi bu çekirdeğin adlaşmış uygulaması olarak gösterir. Birini öfke gibi bir sonuca sürükleme ya da ona bu sonucu kazandırma kullanımı ise aynı edinim şemasının ettirgen genişlemesidir; suç anlamı ancak kötü bir şeyin kazanılması halinde kesişir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel alan kazanıp elde etmedir; birini bir sonuca sürükleme ettirgen bir genişlemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kazanma anlamı, aile için kazanan kişi ve birini belirli bir sonuca sürükleyen yapılardan ayrı ama ilişkili biçimde tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi kazanıp kendi alanına katmak veya başkası için kazanç sağlamaktır. Ettirgen kullanımda birini öfke gibi bir duruma sürüklemek ya da bu sonucu onun üzerine yüklemek anlamına gelir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi kazanma, elde etme ve kendi alanına katma eylemidir.
Bir ailenin geçimini sağlayan ve onun için kazanan kişiyi anlatır.
Birini bir davranışa veya öfke gibi bir sonuca sürükleme ve sonucu ona yükleme anlamına genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt kazanma ve elde etme anlamını, aile adına kazanan kişi kullanımını ve birini bir sonuca taşıyan ettirgen yapıyı birlikte destekler. Kesme ile ilişki, kazanılan şeyin bütünden ayrılıp elde tutulması biçiminde açıklanır.

facets.statement: Bir olay veya yargı için zorunluluk, kaçınılmazlık ve başka seçenek bulunmadığını bildirir.
Bir haberin doğru ve kesin olduğunu vurgulayan doğrulama sözü olarak kullanılır.
Kalıbın farklı söyleyişleri kaydedilir ve kökeni kazanma anlamına bağlayan bir açıklama verilir.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
